name: Molasses
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in small amounts as it doesn't contain significant FODMAPs, but monitor individual tolerance as concentrated sweeteners can sometimes trigger symptoms.
preparationTips: Use as a direct substitute for honey or maple syrup in low FODMAP recipes
Warm slightly before measuring for easier pouring and mixing
Store in a cool, dry place - crystallization is normal and doesn't affect quality
Start with smaller amounts when first introducing to assess tolerance
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in iron, especially blackstrap molasses
Lower glycemic impact than refined sugar
